7568717242628721931.desc: Bangkok Travel Guide (1.5 days itinerary) Bangkok is massive, bold, and the traffic is wild — but it’s one of my favourite big cities in Southeast Asia (with planning!)  I’m a solo female traveler, and here are 5 easy things to do in Bangkok that won’t break your budget or your sanity. 1️⃣ Wat Arun Viewpoint – head there around 5 PM for sunset. Grab a drink at Eagle Nest Bar and watch the temple light up. 2️⃣ Chinatown (Yaowarat) – just 15 min on the MRT from there! It’s buzzing, colourful, and delicious — don’t miss roasted chestnuts or crab fried rice. 3️⃣ Giant Buddha (Wat Paknam Bhasicharoen) – Bangkok’s tallest Buddha. Visit the 5th floor for the glass stupa and incredible views. 4️⃣ ICON SIAM Mall – take the public boat for 10 baht! A perfect mix of culture, street food, and air-con comfort. 5️⃣ Lumphini Park – Bangkok’s calm, green heart. Perfect sunset stroll before dinner. 6️⃣ Central Park Mall & Garden Rooftop – dinner, dessert, and skyline views at their rooftop garden or the elegant bar next door (see my next longer itinerary) #Bangkok #BangkokThailand #VisitBangkok #BangkokTravel #ThingsToDoInBangkok
